path.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the state

items.description: The unique identifier for a child component node. Do not reuse the same component id in multiple parents or multiple children positions.

StaticChildren.description: A static list of child component IDs. Every id in this array must be unique and must not be reused by any other parent node. Create a separate child node for each rendered position.

TemplateChildren.description: A template for generating a dynamic list of child components from a data model list. The `componentId` is the component node to use as a template. Do not reuse this template component id as a static child or as another parent's template; create a dedicated template node for this parent instance.

componentId.description: The unique identifier for a template component node. It must be dedicated to this parent instance and must not be reused elsewhere.

path.description: The path to the list of component property objects in the data model.

maxVisible.description: Maximum number of visible tabs. Excess tabs are collapsed into a 'More' dropdown.

className.description: Tailwind CSS classes for the component.

children.description: Child nodes must be TabItem components. Any child node id must belong to exactly one parent and one child position; never reference the same node id from multiple parents or multiple positions. If using template loop format, the path must point to a tabItems data array and the template componentId must be dedicated to this Tabs instance.
